source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 6 (PDF 76-92), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Data and Analysis) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Data science helps to convert raw data into:
(Data science kachay data (raw data) ko kis cheez mein badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: data science data ko jama karke, analyze (tajziya) karke mufeed maloomat nikalti hai; yeh raw data ko bamaani ilm (meaningful knowledge) mein badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps convert raw data into meaningful knowledge

blocks.prompt:
2 Besides supporting decision-making, data science also helps to:
(Faisla karne mein madad ke ilawa data science aur kis kaam mein madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: data science faislon mein madad deti hai aur mustaqbil ke trends (rujhanat) ki prediction (paishgoi) mein bhi madad karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Data science also helps predict future trends

blocks.prompt:
3 In the data science workflow, before the data is analyzed it is:
(Data science ke workflow mein analysis se pehle data ke saath kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: saaf aur munazzam kiya jata hai
kaghaz par print kiya jata hai

blocks.explanation: 6.1: data mukhtalif sources se jama hota hai, phir analysis se pehle saaf (clean) aur munazzam (organize) kiya jata hai; analysis ke baad nataij ki tashreeh hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The data is cleaned and organized before analysis

blocks.prompt:
4 Which step comes immediately after the analysis of data in data science?
(Data science mein data ke analysis ke foran baad kaun sa qadam aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: analysis ke baad nataij ki ehtiyat se tashreeh (interpretation) ki jati hai; jama karna, saaf karna aur munazzam karna analysis se pehle hote hain.

book_ref.quote: After analysis, the results are interpreted carefully

blocks.prompt:
5 Data science answers questions using facts and data, so it:
(Data science haqaiq aur data se sawalon ke jawab deti hai, is liye yeh:)

options.text: data ki zaroorat khatam karti hai
baghair tools ke kaam karti hai
faisla karne mein andaza kam karti hai

blocks.explanation: 6.1: data science haqaiq aur data se jawab deti hai aur faisla karne mein andazay (guesswork) ko kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It reduces guesswork in decision-making

blocks.prompt:
6 Data science is called interdisciplinary because it:
(Data science ko interdisciplinary (kai shobon par mabni) kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: sirf aik mazmoon istemal karti hai
sirf schools mein kaam karti hai
mukhtalif mazameen ka ilm mila deti hai

blocks.explanation: 6.1: data science mathematics, statistics, computer science, domain knowledge aur communication skills ko mila deti hai; isi milap ki wajah se ise interdisciplinary kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Because of this combination, data science is called interdisciplinary

blocks.prompt:
7 In data science, the subject that helps in analyzing and summarizing data is:
(Data science mein kaun sa mazmoon data ko analyze aur summarize (mukhtasar) karne mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: statistics data ko analyze aur summarize karne mein madad karti hai; mathematics adad aur hisaab ke saath kaam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Statistics helps in analyzing and summarizing data

blocks.prompt:
8 Which field provides tools and programming skills to data science?
(Kaun si field data science ko tools aur programming skills deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: computer science tools aur programming skills deti hai; statistics data ko analyze aur summarize karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Computer science provides tools and programming skills

blocks.prompt:
9 Domain knowledge is needed in data science to:
(Data science mein domain knowledge (mutaliqa shobay ka ilm) kis liye zaroori hai?)

options.text: data cloud mein store karne ke liye

blocks.explanation: 6.1: domain knowledge asal masail samajhne ke liye zaroori hai; communication skills nataij ko wazeh samjhane mein madad karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Domain knowledge is needed to understand real problems

blocks.prompt:
10 In data science, communication skills are used to:
(Data science mein communication skills kis kaam aati hain?)

options.text: sensors se data jama karne ke liye
raw data saaf karne ke liye

blocks.explanation: 6.1: communication skills nataij ko wazeh tor par samjhane mein madad karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Communication skills help explain results clearly

blocks.prompt:
11 Data is best described as:
(Data ki behtareen tareef kya hai?)

options.text: kachay haqaiq aur values ka majmua jis se information banti hai

blocks.explanation: 6.2: data kachay haqaiq aur values ka majmua hai jis se information (maloomat) banti hai; yeh data science ki bunyad hai.

book_ref.quote: Data is a collection of raw facts and values to produce information

blocks.prompt:
12 Which of the following is NOT listed as a form in which data can exist?
(In mein se kaun si shakal data ki shaklon mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: data numbers, text, images, audio ya video ki shakal mein ho sakta hai; algorithm data ki shakal nahi.

book_ref.quote: It can be in the form of numbers, text, images, audio or video

blocks.prompt:
13 According to the chapter, poor understanding of data can lead to:
(Chapter ke mutabiq data ko theek na samajhne ka nateeja kya ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: data ko sahi samajhna durust nataij deta hai; ghalat samajh errors (ghaltiyon) ki taraf le jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Poor data understanding can lead to errors

blocks.prompt:
14 Data kept in a spreadsheet of students' mark sheets is an example of:
(Spreadsheet mein rakhi students ki mark sheets kis qisam ke data ki misal hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: structured data wazeh format, jaise tables ya spreadsheets, mein munazzam hota hai; misal: students ki mark sheets aur databases.

book_ref.quote: Structured data is organized in a clear format, such as tables or spreadsheets

blocks.prompt:
15 Which statement about unstructured data is correct?
(Unstructured data ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Is mein hamesha rows aur columns hote hain
Ise seedha analyze karna mushkil hai aur khaas tools chahiye
Yeh structured data se aasan hai
Jadeed systems ise kabhi istemal nahi karte

blocks.explanation: 6.2: unstructured data ka koi muqarrar format nahi; ise seedha analyze karna mushkil hai aur khaas tools chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Unstructured data is difficult to analyze directly

blocks.prompt:
16 Which types of data do modern systems use?
(Jadeed (modern) systems kis qisam ka data istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: dono qisam ka data ahem hai; jadeed systems structured aur unstructured dono istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Modern systems use both structured and unstructured data

blocks.prompt:
17 Manual data collection differs from automatic data collection because manual collection:
(Manual data collection automatic se kis tarah mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: manual data collection mein insani mehnat lagti hai, jab ke automatic data collection machines aur software istemal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Manual data collection involves human effort

blocks.prompt:
18 Which of these is an automatic source of data according to the chapter's description?
(Chapter ki wazahat ke mutabiq in mein se kaun sa automatic data source hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: sources mein surveys, interviews, forms, sensors aur online platforms shamil hain; automatic collection machines aur software se hoti hai, jaise sensor.

book_ref.quote: Common sources include surveys, interviews, forms, sensors, and online platforms

blocks.prompt:
19 The choice of data collection method depends on:
(Data collection ka tareeqa kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: data real time mein ya waqt ke saath jama ho sakta hai; tareeqa analysis ke maqsad par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The method depends on the purpose of the analysis

blocks.prompt:
20 Which of the following is listed as a place where data can be stored?
(In mein se kaun si jagah data store karne ki jagah ke tor par di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: data storage ka matlab data ko aaynda istemal ke liye mehfooz karna; data files, databases ya cloud systems mein store hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Data can be stored in files, databases, or cloud systems

blocks.prompt:
21 Which part of data management helps to prevent data loss?
(Data management ka kaun sa hissa data zaya hone se bachata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: munasib storage data ko zaya hone se bachati hai aur backup systems data loss rokte hain; security bhi data management ka ahem hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: Backup systems help prevent data loss

blocks.prompt:
22 Data management involves:
(Data management mein kya shamil hai?)

options.text: data ko munazzam rakhna aur sambhalna

blocks.explanation: 6.2: data management mein data ko munazzam rakhna aur sambhalna shamil hai taa ke woh aasani se mil sake aur istemal ho.

book_ref.quote: Data management involves organizing and maintaining data

blocks.prompt:
23 Machine learning enables systems to improve from experience:
(Machine learning systems ko tajurbe se behtar hone deti hai:)

options.text: sirf code dobara likhne ke baad

blocks.explanation: 6.3: machine learning systems ko baghair wazeh (explicit) programming ke tajurbe se behtar hone deti hai.

book_ref.quote: enables systems to improve from experience without explicit programming

blocks.prompt:
24 In machine learning, large datasets are used to:
(Machine learning mein bare datasets kis kaam aate hain?)

options.text: computer ki jagah lene ke liye

blocks.explanation: 6.3: bare datasets models ko train (tarbiyat) karne ke liye istemal hote hain, jo naya data aane par waqt ke saath behtar hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Large datasets are used to train models

blocks.prompt:
25 What happens as a machine learning system processes more data?
(Jab machine learning system zyada data process karta hai to kya hota hai?)

options.text: Woh zyada durust aur efficient ho jata hai
Woh seekhna band kar deta hai
Woh slow aur kam durust ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: 6.3: system pehle se tay rules ke bajaye misalon se seekhta hai; zyada data process karne se woh zyada durust aur efficient hota hai.

book_ref.quote: As the system processes more data, it becomes more accurate and efficient

blocks.prompt:
26 Learning from data is called continuous because:
(Learning from data ko musalsal (continuous) kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: naya data milne par models update hote hain
models sirf aik baar train hote hain

blocks.explanation: 6.3: learning from data musalsal hai kyun ke naya data milne par models update hote rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Learning from data is continuous because the models update when new data is available

blocks.prompt:
27 In learning from data, errors are reduced through:
(Learning from data mein errors kis tarah kam hote hain?)

options.text: haath se naye rules likh kar

blocks.explanation: 6.3: data learning model ko input diya jata hai jo is mein taluqat dhoondta hai; bar bar training se errors kam hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Errors are reduced through repeated training

blocks.prompt:
28 In traditional programming, the output is produced by:
(Traditional programming mein output kis tarah banta hai?)

options.text: data se khud rules seekh kar
milte julte data ko group karke
programmers ke likhe fixed rules par chal kar

blocks.explanation: 6.3: traditional programming mein programmers ke likhe fixed rules hote hain aur output inhi rules par chal kar banta hai; machine learning rules data se seekhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Traditional programming uses fixed rules written by programmers

blocks.prompt:
29 When a change is needed, a machine learning system is updated through:
(Jab tabdeeli chahiye ho to machine learning system kis zariye update hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.3: traditional programming mein tabdeeli ke liye naya code chahiye; machine learning mein tabdeeli naye data se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: In machine learning, changes happen through new data

blocks.prompt:
30 Machine learning mechanisms describe:
(Machine learning mechanisms kya bayan karte hain?)

options.text: systems data se kaise seekhte hain
data files mein kaise store hota hai
charts ka rang kaise hota hai

blocks.explanation: 6.4: machine learning mechanisms (tareeqe) batate hain ke systems data se kaise seekhte hain; mukhtalif masail ke liye mukhtalif mechanisms hain.

book_ref.quote: Machine learning mechanisms describe how systems learn from data

blocks.prompt:
31 In supervised learning, each data item has:
(Supervised learning mein har data item mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: supervised machine learning labeled data (label wala data) istemal karti hai; har item mein input aur sahi output hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each data item has an input and a correct output

blocks.prompt:
32 A supervised learning system learns by:
(Supervised learning system kis tarah seekhta hai?)

options.text: baghair label data ko group karke
sirf fixed rules par chal kar
apna output sahi jawab se mila kar

blocks.explanation: 6.4: supervised system apna output sahi jawab se mila kar seekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The system learns by comparing its output with the correct answer

blocks.prompt:
33 Medical scans labelled as normal or abnormal are used to train which kind of learning?
(Normal ya abnormal label wale medical scans kis qisam ki learning ki training ke liye hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: supervised learning ko bare labelled datasets chahiye, jaise spam/not spam emails, cat/dog images, ya normal/abnormal medical scans.

book_ref.quote: images labelled as cat or dog, or medical scans labelled as normal or abnormal

blocks.prompt:
34 The accuracy of a supervised model usually improves when it is trained on:
(Supervised model ki accuracy aam tor par kab behtar hoti hai?)

options.text: zyada achhi quality wali misalon par

blocks.explanation: 6.4: zyada aur achhi quality ki misalon par training se accuracy aam tor par behtar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Its accuracy usually improves when the model is trained on more high-quality examples

blocks.prompt:
35 Exam result prediction is an example of:
(Exam result ki prediction kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: supervised learning prediction ke kaamon mein istemal hoti hai; misal: email spam detection aur exam result prediction.

book_ref.quote: This method is used for prediction tasks

blocks.prompt:
36 Unsupervised machine learning works with:
(Unsupervised machine learning kis data ke saath kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: unsupervised machine learning baghair label wale (unlabeled) data par kaam karti hai; koi sahi output nahi diya jata.

book_ref.quote: Unsupervised machine learning works with unlabeled data

blocks.prompt:
37 In unsupervised learning, similar data items are grouped together to form:
(Unsupervised learning mein milte julte data items ko jor kar kya banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: unsupervised learning milte julte data ko ikattha karke clusters (guchhe) banati hai; learning data ki mushabihat par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: It groups similar data together and makes clusters

blocks.prompt:
38 A shop groups its customers by their buying habits without any labels. This is:
(Aik dukaan baghair labels ke customers ko khareedari ki aadat se group karti hai. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: unsupervised learning baghair rehnumai ke patterns dhoondti hai; misal: customer grouping aur data clustering.

book_ref.quote: Examples include customer grouping and data clustering

blocks.prompt:
39 Unsupervised learning is especially useful for:
(Unsupervised learning khaas tor par kis kaam ke liye mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: unsupervised learning data mein chhupe hue dhanche (hidden structures) dhoondne aur data exploration ke liye mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: This method is useful for discovering hidden structures

blocks.prompt:
40 In reinforcement learning, the system receives rewards or penalties for its:
(Reinforcement learning mein system ko kis cheez par rewards ya penalties milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: reinforcement learning mein system mahol (environment) se interact karta hai aur apne actions par rewards (inaam) ya penalties (saza) paata hai.

book_ref.quote: It receives rewards or penalties for actions

blocks.prompt:
41 The goal of a reinforcement learning system is to:
(Reinforcement learning system ka maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: har data item ko label karna

blocks.explanation: 6.4: learning trial and error (koshish aur ghalti) se chalti hai aur maqsad rewards ko zyada se zyada karna hai.

book_ref.quote: The goal is to maximize rewards

blocks.prompt:
42 AlphaGo improving its strategy by playing Go is an example of:
(AlphaGo ka Go khel kar apni strategy behtar karna kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: reinforcement learning ki misalein: maze mein robot, Go khel kar behtar hota AlphaGo, aur driving behtar karti autonomous car.

book_ref.quote: AlphaGo improving its strategy by playing Go

blocks.prompt:
43 Reinforcement learning is mainly used in:
(Reinforcement learning zyada tar kahan istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: reinforcement learning robotics aur games mein istemal hoti hai aur tajurbe se insani seekhne ki naqal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: This method is used in robotics and games

blocks.prompt:
44 One general benefit of machine learning applications is that they:
(Machine learning applications ka aik aam faida kya hai?)

options.text: insani mehnat kam aur waqt bachati hain
sirf chhote data par chalti hain

blocks.explanation: 6.5: machine learning bara data jaldi analyze karti hai; bohat se systems khud kaam karte hain, jis se insani mehnat kam aur waqt bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: It reduces human effort and saves time

blocks.prompt:
45 In healthcare, machine learning can help to detect cancerous cells in:
(Healthcare mein machine learning cancer ke cells kis cheez mein dhoondne mein madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: healthcare mein machine learning medical data analyze karti hai; misal ke tor par medical images mein cancer wale cells dhoondne mein madad karti hai.

book_ref.quote: it can help detect cancerous cells in medical images

blocks.prompt:
46 Which of the following is a healthcare use of machine learning mentioned in the chapter?
(Chapter mein di gayi healthcare mein machine learning ki aik misal kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: machine learning Alzheimer's ya dementia ki ibtidai alamaat pehchan sakti hai aur dil ki bimariyon ki tashkhees mein madad karti hai.

book_ref.quote: identify early signs of Alzheimer's disease or dementia

blocks.prompt:
47 Which of the following is a business use of machine learning?
(In mein se business mein machine learning ka istemal kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: businesses machine learning se customer ka rawaiya samajhte, sales aur market trends predict karte aur inventory management (maal ka intezam) karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Businesses use it for inventory management

blocks.prompt:
48 Detecting fraud in financial systems is an application of machine learning in:
(Financial systems mein fraud (dhoka) pakarna machine learning ka kis shobay mein istemal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: business ki misalein: financial systems mein fraud pakarna, chatbots se customer service aur products suggest karna.

book_ref.quote: Examples include detecting fraud in financial systems

blocks.prompt:
49 With machine learning, business decisions become:
(Machine learning se business ke faisle kaise ho jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: business ke faisle data par mabni (data-driven) ho jate hain, jis se munafa aur efficiency barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Business decisions become data-driven

blocks.prompt:
50 In education, machine learning provides:
(Taleem mein machine learning kya faraham karti hai?)

options.text: har student ke mutabiq learning content

blocks.explanation: 6.5: taleem mein machine learning students ki karkardagi track karti hai, har student ke mutabiq (personalized) learning content deti hai aur attendance aur assessment ko smart banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Personalized learning content is provided

blocks.prompt:
51 Which everyday application uses machine learning to filter unwanted messages?
(Kaun si rozmarra application na-pasandeeda messages filter karne ke liye machine learning istemal karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: email services spam messages filter karti hain; navigation apps raastay batati hain aur voice assistants bolay gaye hukm samajhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Email services filter spam messages

blocks.prompt:
52 Mobile phones use machine learning for:
(Mobile phones machine learning kis kaam ke liye istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: rozmarra zindagi mein mobile phones chehra pehchanne (face recognition) ke liye machine learning istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Mobile phones use it for face recognition

blocks.prompt:
53 Online platforms that recommend videos and music are an example of machine learning in:
(Videos aur music recommend karne wale online platforms kis shobay mein machine learning ki misal hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.5: rozmarra misalon mein videos aur music recommend karne wale online platforms aur personalized content dikhata social media shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Online platforms recommend videos and music

blocks.prompt:
54 In the student grade prediction example, the important values selected to help the model are called:
(Student grade prediction ki misal mein model ki madad ke liye chuni gayi ahem values ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.6: ahem values ko features kehte hain; yeh model ko samjhati hain ke kaun se awamil student ki karkardagi par asar dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Important values, also called features, are selected

blocks.prompt:
55 The student grade prediction model helps teachers to:
(Student grade prediction model teachers ki kis tarah madad karta hai?)

options.text: final exam se pehle extra madad ke mohtaaj students pehchanna
kamzor students ko class se nikalna

blocks.explanation: 6.6: train hone ke baad model student ka mumkina grade batata hai; is se teachers final exam se pehle un students ko pehchan lete hain jinhein extra madad chahiye.

book_ref.quote: This helps teachers identify students who may need extra support before the final examination

blocks.prompt:
56 Two models are tested on the same data. Model A has MSE 0.35 and model B has MSE 0.12. Which statement is correct?
(Do models aik hi data par test hue. Model A ka MSE 0.35 aur model B ka 0.12 hai. Kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Model A behtar hai kyun ke us ka MSE bara hai
Model B behtar hai kyun ke us ki predictions asal values ke qareeb hain
MSE se models compare nahi ho sakte

blocks.explanation: 6.6: kam MSE behtar karkardagi dikhata hai kyun ke predicted values asal values ke qareeb hoti hain; 0.12 < 0.35.

book_ref.quote: A lower MSE indicates better model performance

blocks.prompt:
57 In the hours-vs-scores example, the model is trained using:
(Hours-vs-scores ki misal mein model kis data se train hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.6: linear regression model training data (X_train, y_train) par banaya aur train kiya jata hai; phir X_test par test hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A linear regression model is created and trained on the training data

blocks.prompt:
58 In the regression example, the X values and the y values represent:
(Regression ki misal mein X values aur y values kya dikhati hain?)

options.text: exam scores aur parhai ke ghante
parhai ke ghante aur exam scores

blocks.explanation: 6.6: X values parhai ke ghante (hours studied) aur y values un ke mutabiq exam scores hain.

book_ref.quote: The X values represent hours studied

blocks.prompt:
59 In the chapter's regression example, the model's performance is evaluated using:
(Chapter ki regression misal mein model ki karkardagi kis se jaanchi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.6: model training data par train hota hai aur us ki karkardagi Mean Squared Error (MSE) se jaanchi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: its performance is evaluated using Mean Squared Error (MSE)

blocks.prompt:
60 With the corrected program, the model equation for the hours-vs-scores data is Exam Score = 0.6552 x Hours Studied + 0.1466. What score does it predict for 9 hours (to 4 decimal places)?
(Durust program ke saath model equation Exam Score = 0.6552 x Hours Studied + 0.1466 hai. 9 ghante ke liye yeh kya score predict karti hai (4 decimal tak)?)
blocks.explanation: 6.6: 0.6552 x 9 + 0.1466 = 5.8968 + 0.1466 = 6.0434 (data mein 9 ghante ka asal score 6 hai, is ke qareeb).

book_ref.quote: The numbers in the printed output are right

blocks.prompt:
61 In a model, target values are:
(Model mein target values kya hoti hain?)

options.text: woh output jinhein predict karna hai

blocks.explanation: 6.6: features woh input values hain jo model istemal karta hai; target values woh output hain jinhein predict karna hai.

book_ref.quote: Target values are the outputs to be predicted

blocks.prompt:
62 Adding unnecessary features to a model can:
(Model mein ghair zaroori features shamil karne se kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: tamam errors khatam kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: 6.6: sahi features chunna learning behtar karta hai; ghair zaroori features accuracy kam kar sakte hain. Features masle se mutaliq hone chahiyein.

book_ref.quote: Unnecessary features can reduce accuracy

blocks.prompt:
63 A model predicts students' marks from their attendance. Here attendance is the:
(Aik model attendance se students ke marks predict karta hai. Yahan attendance kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.6: features input hain aur target predict hone wala output; yahan attendance input (feature) hai aur marks target.

book_ref.quote: When predicting student marks, study hours would be the feature

blocks.prompt:
64 Feature engineering includes:
(Feature engineering mein kya shamil hai?)

options.text: features chunna, badalna aur naye banana

blocks.explanation: 6.6: feature engineering behtar learning ke liye data ko behtar banana hai; is mein features chunna, badalna aur naye banana shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: It includes selecting, modifying, and creating features

blocks.prompt:
65 Why is feature engineering needed?
(Feature engineering ki zaroorat kyun hai?)

options.text: Models koi number istemal nahi kar sakte
Raw data aksar tayyar nahi hota aur use cleaning aur scaling chahiye
Raw data hamesha mukammal hota hai
Is se training ki zaroorat khatam ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: 6.6: raw data aksar models ke liye tayyar nahi hota; use cleaning (safai) aur scaling chahiye hoti hai. Feature engineering model ki karkardagi behtar karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Raw data is often not ready for models

blocks.prompt:
66 Creating a new feature such as "study hours per day" from raw study-hours data is an example of:
